Carlson Capital Management Has Lowered Its Wells Fargo & Co New (WFC) Stake as Market Valuation Declined; Hrg Group (HRG) Share Price Declined While Alpine Partners Vi Lifted Holding by $3.60 Million
June 12, 2018 - By Clifton Ray
Carlson Capital Management decreased its stake in Wells Fargo & Co New (WFC) by 20.44% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Carlson Capital Management sold 6,109 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.45% with the market. The institutional investor held 23,773 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $1.25M, down from 29,882 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Carlson Capital Management who had been investing in Wells Fargo & Co New for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $271.61 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.41% or $0.23 during the last trading session, reaching $55.74. About 3.67M shares traded. Wells Fargo & Company (NYSE:WFC) has risen 4.02% since June 12, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 8.55% the S&P500. Alpine Partners Vi Llc increased its stake in Hrg Group Inc (HRG) by 225% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Alpine Partners Vi Llc bought 225,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 23.38% with the market. The institutional investor held 325,000 shares of the miscellaneous company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $5.36M, up from 100,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Alpine Partners Vi Llc who had been investing in Hrg Group Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $2.65B market cap company. The stock increased 1.48% or $0.19 during the last trading session, reaching $13.06. About 138,451 shares traded. HRG Group, Inc. (NYSE:HRG) has declined 31.30% since June 12, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 43.87% the S&P500.
Alpine Partners Vi Llc, which manages about $424.83 million US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 18,254 shares to 9,499 shares, valued at $1.59 million in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Monsanto Co New (NYSE:MON) by 16,950 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 200,550 shares, and cut its stake in Facebook Inc (NASDAQ:FB).
Another recent and important HRG Group, Inc. (NYSE:HRG) news was published by Businesswire.com which published an article titled: “Spectrum Brands and HRG Group Announce July 13, 2018 as the Date for Special Meetings of Stockholders” on June 12, 2018.
Analysts await Wells Fargo & Company (NYSE:WFC) to report earnings on July, 13. They expect $1.12 earnings per share, up 4.67% or $0.05 from last year’s $1.07 per share. WFC’s profit will be $5.46B for 12.44 P/E if the $1.12 EPS becomes a reality.
